title: Report logical assembly locations and handle missing physical files
goal: Give diagnostics a stable logical assembly label while preserving unrelated locations and handling stream-loaded, single-file and Native AOT assemblies without physical paths.

selectionNotes: SetAssemblyLocationOverride is static, process-wide and set-once. Configure only in a host you control; never call Assembly.Location recursively inside the callback.
A logical override does not create a file or change assembly resolution. Single-file, stream-loaded and Native AOT locations may be empty; the custom callback example is checked on CoreCLR only.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The newer framework APIs and caller behavior are .NET 11 contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 artifacts are test baselines.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Declared canonical sample language mode; these APIs need no preview language syntax.

platforms: CoreCLR on supported .NET 11 platforms for the file-based metadata/custom-loader example; Windows x64 for the recorded Native AOT publications.
prerequisites: SDK console project with TargetFramework=net11.0, LangVersion=15.0, ImplicitUsings=enable and Nullable=enable. Put declarations in namespace Playbook.Samples.
Native AOT publication requires a supported native compiler/linker and OS SDK. The tested Windows x64 tools and exact dependency closures are recorded per publication.
constraints: SetAssemblyLocationOverride is static, process-wide and set-once. Configure only in a host you control; never call Assembly.Location recursively inside the callback.
A logical override does not create a file or change assembly resolution. Single-file, stream-loaded and Native AOT locations may be empty; the custom callback example is checked on CoreCLR only.
No query provider, rendering integration, external account, resource provisioning or optional workload is required. No unverified older-target route is advertised.

The custom location callback needs only framework assemblies. The separate metadata-inspection project also restores MetadataLoadContext for its independent checks; that package is not a prerequisite of the callback.
stabilityLimitations: Verified with .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. These selected APIs have no publisher experimental annotation or required experimental opt-in.

evidence.scope: Real CoreCLR compilation/execution checks metadata-only context ownership, nullable Int32 and constructor arity, a stream-loaded assembly and process-wide logical location reporting. Untrimmed file-based host; no Native AOT or editor claims.
